title: A new look for Tamkeen
question: Choose the direction for the entire website. Both keep quizzes easy to take and teacher tools private.

options.label: Discovery Club
options.thesis: A bright learning club with big, tactile quiz controls and an unmistakable winners’ podium.
options.viewport: A cobalt club header, a quiz list on the left, and live class standings on the right for the teacher.
options.risk: Expressive color needs restraint in long forms and Arabic questions.

raised.raise: One shared numerical scale makes every leaderboard position immediately comparable.
The same navigation and quiz-progress landmarks persist across every screen.
Useful quiz and result content starts in the first viewport instead of below a marketing hero.
During a quiz, a single question gets the full reading area.
Score columns align exactly and teacher tools follow a consistent working grid.
Large scores and readable labels carry hierarchy without ornamental icons.

options.label: The Tamkeen League
options.lineage: Youth tournament scoreboards and team sheets
options.thesis: A friendly quiz league: visible standings, colorful quiz rows, and a focused match-day quiz flow.
options.viewport: A compact navy masthead, the latest quiz as the main action, and a gold-accent podium beside the teacher’s standings.
options.risk: Sports-scoreboard language is familiar; the craft must keep it from looking like another dashboard.

options.label: Star atlas
options.viewport: Ranked points across a constellation chart.
options.risk: The chart hides exact grades and invents relationships between students.
options.case: Loses audience identification and result clarity against a learning club.
options.kept: A single comparable scale for standings.

options.label: Transit diagram
options.thesis: Quizzes become stops along a learning route.
options.viewport: Routes connect quiz stations and results.
options.risk: We have no real course sequence to map.
options.case: Invents a curriculum structure and makes a simple quiz list harder to scan.

options.label: Dense information mosaic
options.thesis: Quizzes and scores tile into a compact module grid.
options.viewport: Every feature fits in a tightly packed grid.
options.risk: Repeats the readability problem you explicitly rejected.
options.case: Both audience fit and clarity lose to larger task-focused controls.
options.kept: Show useful content in the first screen.

options.label: Full-screen quiz feed
options.thesis: One question owns each screen, like a vertical feed.
options.viewport: A single question occupies the whole page.
options.risk: A feed hides the quiz library and teacher tasks.
options.case: Works for a question but loses clarity across the whole product.
options.kept: One focused question during an attempt.

options.label: Ruled reference sheet
options.thesis: A precise printed reference layout with an annotated center rail.
options.viewport: Two columns surround a keyed center rail.
options.risk: Its formal reading vocabulary misses the playful youth-group brief.
options.case: The student audience and navigation are better served by direct controls.
options.kept: Precise data alignment and form rhythm.

options.label: Interactive type specimen
options.thesis: Huge score numerals and a responsive glyph grid.
options.viewport: One large number dominates a sparse page.
options.risk: A type experiment would displace quizzes and standings.
options.case: Its controls have no truthful job in this learning app.

canonCard.label: Familiar learning platform
canonCard.thesis: A conventional quiz platform with polished forms and straightforward navigation.
canonCard.viewport: Quiz list, results table, and a teacher workspace.
canonCard.risk: Familiar by choice, with less character than the club directions.
